services.title: Assignment Help
services.shortDescription: Well-researched, subject-specific assignment support with proper structure and referencing.
services.fullDescription: Get help understanding your assignment brief, structuring your answer, and polishing the final write-up. Share your assignment question, subject, word limit, and university formatting guidelines, and get a draft you can review, learn from, and submit in your own words.
services.subject: Any subject
services.requirements:
Assignment question/PDF
Subject and course code
Word limit
Formatting style (APA/MLA/university format)
Deadline
services.instructions: Please share the exact assignment brief and your university's submission guidelines so the work matches what your instructor expects. This service is meant to support your learning, not to replace it -- please review and understand the content before submitting.

services.title: Project Help
services.shortDescription: Guidance and hands-on support for academic mini/major projects, reports, and presentations.
services.fullDescription: Support for semester mini-projects and major projects -- from topic selection and synopsis writing to report structuring, code/documentation review, and presentation slides. Suited for engineering, management, and computer science project submissions.
services.subject: Any subject
services.requirements:
Project topic or domain
Course/branch and semester
Guidelines/rubric from your department
Any existing work already done
services.instructions: Share as much detail as you can about what your project needs to cover. Pricing depends on project scope, so a quote will be shared after reviewing your requirements.

services.title: Subject Help / Doubt Solving
services.shortDescription: Topic-wise explanations and exam-prep support across core university subjects.
services.fullDescription: One-on-one help understanding tricky topics, solving numericals, and preparing for internal exams, quizzes, and vivas. Tell us your subject and specific chapters or doubts, and get clear, exam-focused explanations.
services.subject: Any subject
services.requirements:
Subject name and topic/chapter
Specific doubts or questions
Preferred timing for a session (if live)
services.instructions: Let us know whether you'd prefer written explanations or a live doubt-solving session, and we'll confirm availability and pricing accordingly.

services.title: Coursera Course Completion Help
services.shortDescription: Support completing Coursera courses, graded quizzes, and peer-reviewed assignments.
services.fullDescription: Help working through Coursera course modules, understanding video lectures, and completing graded quizzes and peer-review assignments on time -- useful for university-mandated MOOC/certification requirements.
services.requirements:
Coursera course name/link
Submission deadline
How you'd like to proceed (guided by you, or done on your behalf)
services.instructions: Pricing depends on the course length and number of graded components. Share the exact course link so an accurate quote and timeline can be given.

services.title: LinkedIn Learning Course Help
services.shortDescription: Assistance completing LinkedIn Learning courses and earning certificates for your profile/resume.
services.fullDescription: Guidance to work through LinkedIn Learning video courses and assessments efficiently, so you can add the completion certificate to your LinkedIn profile and resume for placements and internships.
services.requirements:
LinkedIn Learning course name/link
Deadline (if any)
Whether you want the certificate added to your profile too
services.instructions: Final pricing depends on course duration. Share the course link for an accurate quote.

services.title: Resume & LinkedIn Profile Help
services.shortDescription: Resume building and LinkedIn profile improvement for internships and placements.
services.fullDescription: Help creating or improving a student resume and LinkedIn profile -- structuring sections, writing project/experience bullet points, and general presentation, tailored for internship and placement applications.
services.requirements:
Current resume (if any)
Course/branch and year
Target role or internship type
Key projects, skills, and achievements
services.instructions: Share whatever draft or details you already have -- even rough notes work. You'll get a reviewed, structured version back.
